question: In a certain code language, 'SHARP' is written as ' LOATN'. How will 'VAPID' be written in that language?
solution:
'SHARP' is written as 'LOATN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45842100225920ac6b9f2e42e8ea8c3d8199ab6eca7e30649f6805f7427d2d9d.png] 

Similarly,

'VAPID' is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40cefdbbef7306aa02aea34dc2185aeee3f942539d11a66efc38a630421f4931.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ERPHE".**
